newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA INFORMATION GROUP IN JOINT U.S. VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA INFORMATION GROUP IN JOINT U.S. VENTURE.

text.p: South African news and information vendor INET said on Thursday it had entered a joint venture deal with global information group Bridge Information Systems.
Bridge would take an equity stake in INET, which is jointly owned by South African media group Times Media Limited and a consortium of private investors, INET said in a statement.

Bridge, which is headquartered in New York, was formed by the merger over the past 24 months of Knight Ridder Financial, Bridge Information Systems, EJV Partners and Market Vision, the statement said.
